description: Change or CLOSE a SimplifyQA release. Read releases with sqa_query (collection "releases"). Pass `releaseId` (id, code like RE-44, or exact name) and either `close:true` (sets the project's completed-type state and the actual end date) or `state`, and/or name, dates, description, estimatedEffort, ownerIds. It reads the release back and reports the stored state. Only an admin user can edit a release in SimplifyQA. Closing warns when the release still has sprints that are not completed.

close.description: true = close it: the project's completed-type state (Completed / Released / Closed) and the actual end date. Use this for "close release RE-44".

ownerIds.description: Owner user ids (replaces the current owners).

plannedEndDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

releaseId.description: Release id, code (RE-44) or exact name.

state.description: The state to set, as the project names it (e.g. "In-progress", "Completed"). An unknown state is refused with the valid ones listed.

name: release_update
title: Update or close a release (SimplifyQA)
